description: Return every element matching a CSS selector as { ref, role, name, bbox }, capped at `limit` (default 50, max 200). When more matched than returned,  `truncated` is the number dropped and `count` is the true total. Returns: { ok, session_id, matches, count, truncated }. Errors: TRANSPORT_UNSUPPORTED, NOT_RUNNING, BAD_ARGUMENT (invalid selector, limit, or multiple sessions).

sessionId.description: Target session id. Omit when a single session is running.

name: electron_elements_list
title: List elements matching a selector
